provider_policy.desktop_app_policy: Exclude projects that require an additional desktop app or local app backend.
provider_policy.status_policy: needs_provider_keys, needs_api_key and needs_model_access are configuration states, not deletion criteria, when the route is restricted to an allowed first-party model provider.

explainer_html_video.reserve_policy: Keep all registered alternatives. Activate them only for a director-routed scene, a format adaptation, or a documented primary-route failure.

vox_explainer_video.reserve_policy: Keep all registered alternatives, but use generated footage only for explanation or transitions and never as real-world evidence.

talking_head_video.reserve_policy: Use approved real-person footage and its original human audio as the only presenter source. Digital-human work migrates to digital_human_video.

digital_human_video.reserve_policy: Generate each presenter independently, approve a short sample for each, keep generated presenter videos silent, and composite single or dual-speaker turns on the Remotion master timeline.

commercial_promo_video.reserve_policy: Official brand and product assets are primary. Generated visuals may create concepts, atmosphere, or transitions, but cannot prove product capability, customer results, price, or offer.

cinematic_short_drama_video.reserve_policy: Planning and registration only. Paid external generation remains disabled until the user explicitly approves provider, budget, rights, and safety preflight.
